Hannah: Quick sync before we go live — keynote order needs flipping: move product deep-dive ahead of customer spotlight. That'll change slide timings and the NDI feed cues. Can ops confirm safe NDI failover?
Owen: Roger. I'm patching the presenter switcher now and will hold scene transitions until we confirm recorder continuity.
Priya: Saw a micro-drop on the NDI path during rehearsal (about 12s). Starting local SD fallback recorder and switching NDI to redundant-path in 15s.
NDIBot: ndi-route switched to backup-path-4 :white_check_mark: 
Priya: Kickoff command:
recctl start --id ah-3160 --dest /recs/allhands-3160-fallback.mp4 --mode sd
RecorderBot: started recording (id: r-3160-1)
Hannah: Thanks. Also add a 15s buffer between the deep-dive and customer story for captions to re-sync — last run had drift.
Owen: Added buffer in MC notes and updated slide timestamps. Pushing new deck in ~30s.
Mia (CEO): Good call. We'll call out the order change at the intro and reserve a 6-minute block after roadmap for pricing Qs (monthly vs annual commits) and autoscaler timeline. Mark autoscaler as "planned (Q2 design)" on slide.
Priya: Encoder stable on backup path, no frame drops in last check. I'll monitor and ping if anything regresses.
Hannah: Post-meeting tasks: Priya to attach raw recording to INF-920, Owen to export a 10-min highlight for comms, Product to prep pricing FAQ.
Owen: Will export and upload clip after session.
Priya: INF-920 created, will attach upload when done.
Hannah: OK moving to live in 1 minute. If anyone sees glitches, ping here and I'll cut to SD backup. Good luck.
Owen: Feed looks clean, captions re-synced.
RecorderBot: upload queued, link to be posted when complete.
Mia (CEO): Thanks team  see you on the call.
Hannah: Closing thread and monitoring live.
